title: Yellow.ai is going public to buy the call centres it wants to replace with AI
excerpt: Yellow.ai is merging with SPAC Bluerock to list on Nasdaq at ~$550M, and plans to buy the outsourcing firms it wants to rebuild as AI.
content_html:
Most AI companies want to sell software to call centres. Yellow.ai wants to buy the call centres. The enterprise-AI firm has agreed to go public through a merger with a blank-cheque company. It plans to spend much of the money acquiring the outsourcing operators it aims to automate.

The deal folds Yellow.ai into Bluerock Acquisition Corp, a Nasdaq-listed SPAC, with the combined company trading as “YAI.” It puts the pro forma equity value at about $550m and expects more than $200m in proceeds. Both boards have approved. Bluerock’s shareholders have not yet voted, and closing is due in the second half of 2026.

Yellow.ai, founded in 2016, sells agentic AI that turns a company’s service procedures into agents that plan a task, act on it and close it out. It says it handles 16 billion conversations a year for more than 650 enterprise clients, and booked over $34m in unaudited revenue last year. Backers include Lightspeed and Salesforce Ventures.

Buying the market it wants to automate

The unusual part is what the cash is for. Alongside the platform and sales, Yellow.ai earmarks proceeds to acquire business process outsourcing firms, the operators that run customer service for other companies, and rebuild them on its own software. It has hired for the job: one new partner brings outsourcing operations, another private-equity roll-up experience.

That changes what the company is. A pure platform sells seats to firms that run their own desks. A platform that owns the desks captures the labour spend directly, but inherits the payroll, attrition and client-contract risk that comes with it. Yellow.ai is betting the labour budget itself, not the software licence, is the prize.

The number behind the bet is large. Yellow.ai pegs outsourcing at a $384bn market where roughly 85% of service calls are still answered by people. It projects $906bn by 2035, with the AI-agent slice growing from $12bn to $295bn. That is the reallocation of human work it wants to own both sides of.

A rich price and a SPAC

The caveats are not small. At a roughly $300m pre-money valuation, Yellow.ai is priced at about nine times its reported revenue, Unite.ai noted. It is also a SPAC, a structure that has fallen from favour. Most of the cash sits in a trust that only arrives in full if Bluerock’s holders do not redeem. The release flags that risk plainly.

The bull case is that Yellow.ai is not a concept. It has production scale, a Forrester “Strong Performer” rating, and a voice product that is its fastest-growing line, competing with the wider field of enterprise agents. If AI really does eat the call centre, owning the call centre may be the smartest seat in the room. The vote and the filings come next.

content_html_zh:
大多数人工智能公司都希望向呼叫中心出售软件。 Yellow.ai 想收购呼叫中心。 这家企业人工智能公司已同意通过与一家空白支票公司合并的方式上市。 它计划花费大量资金收购旨在实现自动化的外包运营商。

该交易将 Yellow.ai 并入 Bluerock Acquisition Corp（一家在纳斯达克上市的 SPAC），合并后的公司交易名为“YAI”。 预计股权价值约为 5.5 亿美元，预计收益将超过 2 亿美元。 两个董事会均已批准。 Bluerock 的股东尚未投票，交割预计将于 2026 年下半年完成。

Yellow.ai 成立于 2016 年，销售代理人工智能，将公司的服务流程转变为代理，规划任务、执行任务并结束任务。 该公司表示，每年为 650 多家企业客户处理 160 亿次对话，去年未经审计的收入超过 3400 万美元。 支持者包括 Lightspeed 和 Salesforce Ventures。

购买它想要自动化的市场

不寻常的部分是现金的用途。 除了平台和销售之外，Yellow.ai 还专门收购业务流程外包公司、为其他公司提供客户服务的运营商，并用自己的软件重建它们。 它已经聘请了该职位：一位新合作伙伴带来了外包业务，另一种私募股权汇总经验。

这改变了公司的本质。 一个纯粹的平台向拥有自己办公桌的公司出售席位。 拥有办公桌的平台可以直接捕获劳动力支出，但会继承随之而来的工资、人员流失和客户合同风险。 Yellow.ai 的赌注是劳动力预算本身，而不是软件许可证。

下注背后的数字很大。 Yellow.ai 将外包瞄准了价值 3840 亿美元的市场，该市场大约 85% 的服务电话仍然由人工接听。 它预计到 2035 年将达到 9060 亿美元，其中人工智能代理份额将从 120 亿美元增长到 2950 亿美元。 这就是它希望双方都拥有的人类工作的重新分配。

丰富的价格和SPAC

警告不小。 Unite.ai 指出，Yellow.ai 的投前估值约为 3 亿美元，其定价约为其报告收入的九倍。 它也是一个SPAC，一种已经失宠的结构。 大部分现金都存放在一个信托中，只有在 Bluerock 的持有人不赎回的情况下，该信托才能全额到位。 该版本明确标记了这种风险。

最乐观的情况是 Yellow.ai 不是一个概念。 它拥有生产规模、Forrester“表现强劲”评级，并且语音产品是其增长最快的产品线，与更广泛的企业代理领域竞争。 如果人工智能真的吃掉了呼叫中心，那么拥有呼叫中心可能是房间里最聪明的座位。 接下来是投票和提交文件。
